changeSet.author: oneubank

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m_role WHERE name = 'Banking API'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM m_role r, m_permission p WHERE r.name = 'Banking API' AND p.code IN ( -- Customers: create (with their first account), search, KYC level and other client details 'CREATE_CLIENT', 'ACTIVATE_CLIENT', 'READ_CLIENT', 'UPDATE_CLIENT', -- BVN and other identifiers: stored on create, searched by 'CREATE_CLIENTIDENTIFIER', 'READ_CLIENTIDENTIFIER', -- Accounts and static virtual accounts: open, read with balances and transactions, close 'CREATE_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'APPROVE_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'ACTIVATE_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'READ_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'CLOSE_SAVINGSACCOUNT', -- Intra-bank transfers and sweeps out of virtual accounts 'CREATE_ACCOUNTTRANSFER', 'READ_ACCOUNTTRANSFER', -- Interbank transfers and service debits; reversing a debit when the transfer fails 'WITHDRAWAL_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'DEPOSIT_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'REVERSETRANSACTION_SAVINGSACCOUNT', -- Holds 'HOLDAMOUNT_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'RELEASEAMOUNT_SAVINGSACCOUNT', -- Blocks: credit, debit, all 'BLOCK_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'UNBLOCK_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'BLOCKDEBIT_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'UNBLOCKDEBIT_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'BLOCKCREDIT_SAVINGSACCOUNT', 'UNBLOCKCREDIT_SAVINGSACCOUNT', -- Who placed a block: the client through the Banking API, or the bank 'READ_AUDIT', -- Products, payment types, and code values (virtual account types, risk ratings) 'READ_SAVINGSPRODUCT', 'READ_PAYMENTTYPE', 'READ_CODEVALUE' ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);
